notes.title: Im back and updating the game!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Just letting you know that I am back and working on the game again! This is going to be a pretty big update when its done. 

List of things I am working on:
- Redoing Items(having level and stat req)
- More Equipment slots
- Item sets
- Player Housing 
- More Content 
- Bug Fixes 
- Adding more story and lore to the world
- Steam Cards and Steam Achievements

Thank you to everyone that has supported me!
-Ty

notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.content:
Hey guys this update is the most unfinished build yet. I plan to update again soon after I get a chance to do more testing. Anyways changes:

- New Areas 

- Updated Main Temple.
- Ice Temple - Boss coming soon!

- 30+ new items.

- In-game Time doubled.

- Mining and Fishing Nodes now reset every night at 21:00.

- Minor Bug-fixes and Balance changes.

I plan on having the Ice Temple side areas and boss fight done in the next 2 weeks.  Plus more items and more work done to the fishing system. 


P.s You can catch me streaming live Fallen Temple Development from 8am EST to 1PM Monday to Friday. Come give your feedback @ http://www.twitch.tv/zingod

Thank you
-Tyone

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone the update should be live very soon. 

In this update I re-did a lot of the old systems and added in some new ones. I didn't get to finish all the new content I would have liked but I hope you have fun testing the new systems.

Systems:

Re-did: Items and loot drop. I completely re-did the loot charts and there is a new item tier level.


NEW: Item tiers: From lowest to highest: White, Green, Blue, Purple, Red. Also there is Corrupted items: Black and Unique items: Brown.

NEW: Quest log: You now have a quest log that tracks quest in your menu.

NEW: In-game Time: 24 hour 7 day clock. Not much has been done with this yet but you can mess around with it with an item in a chest in town. 

NEW: Gathering systems: Fishing and Mining can be leveled up and woodcutting dose not. This is just the start.

Hotkey Item bindings changed: Crtl, ALT to Q, W. This should allow you to use hotkeys while using a controller. 

Balancing changes:

With all the new items in the game, I have done a lot of balancing to enemies and bosses. The first boss should be much easier than before.

Sound levels have been adjusted. 

New music for sewer level and inside the temple.

Some new side areas.

I am getting closer to how the final game systems will work. My next goal is to get some new content done within the new 2 weeks. Please feel free to leave feedback on anything in the forums.

Thank you,
-Tyrone
